## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small and focused, and commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, and they fail without the change where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and public interfaces were updated.
- [ ] The change respects the [constitution](.specify/memory/constitution.md), including
      subsystem boundaries and local-first operation.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tokens or personal data are included in code, logs or tests.
- [ ] New dependencies are justified and license-compatible with Apache-2.0.
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated if the change affects architecture, security, persistence,
      compatibility or deployment.
- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the project's Apache-2.0 license and to follow
      the Code of Conduct.
